remaining_gaps: The replication gate does not yet emit tenant_id, artifact_checksum, validated_universe, return_basis or periods_per_year in its verdict, and nothing persists the verdict to registry entry metadata.replication_gate_verdict; until it does every member resolves to explicit no_approved_baseline (fail-closed, no defaults).
The runtime has no production registry reader injected (_member_entry_reader is unset), so hosted runtimes report registry_entry_missing; wiring is an owner-contract follow-up outside this scope.
Tests use local fixtures, not recorded Taiwan gate output; no hosted market-day claim.
Autonomous member actions remain with EVOLUTION-POOL-MEMBER-ACTIONS and POOL-ADMISSION-AND-WEIGHTS.
